narr: An upper level trough over the eastern Gulf of Mexico along with moist SW wind flow led to a prolonged period of major flooding in southern Miami-Dade County. Rainfall on Monday, June 6th and early Tuesday June 7th associated with a surge of moisture in the wake of the June 3-4 tropical disturbance led to localized very heavy rainfall of 5-8 inches in portions of South Miami-Dade County, aggravating pre-existing flooding and causing additional major flooding.
ev: Major flooding was reported in the Saga Bay and surrounding neighborhoods in Cutler Bay. Streets were flooded with over 2 feet of water which blocked off the neighborhood for almost 2 days. Water covered front yards and approached garages and front doors of homes. ||Rainfall of up to 8 inches was measured in the area from the afternoon of June 6th to the early morning of June 7th.
